data.one_liner: Flutter extension for Hive database initialization and path management
data.what_it_does: Provides helper functions like initFlutter to easily integrate the Hive database into Flutter applications. It automatically configures storage paths using path_provider and registers default adapters.
use_when: You are using Hive or hive_ce in a Flutter application
You need automatic path initialization for local device storage
avoid_when: You are building a pure Dart application without Flutter
Not using Hive for local storage
strengths: Simplifies Hive setup on Flutter platforms
Handles automatic flushing of boxes on app pause
weaknesses: Depends entirely on hive_ce for actual storage functionality
data.setup_notes: Call Hive.initFlutter() before using Hive boxes in your app.
